name: trekking-pole
description: A trekking pole with a complete grip, wrist loop, shaft and lower basket.
useCase: Identify trekking poles or hiking support equipment.
misuse: Use a visible label when equipment identifies a product, outdoor activity or required gear.

16.reason: A narrow grip and wrist loop sit above the long full shaft and small lower basket.

24.reason: The long shaft remains dominant below the complete grip and wrist loop, above the small basket.
